boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten documented SRU study environments spanning quiet desks, collaborative areas, lounges, and an outdoor setting.

cards.title: Bailey Library First-Floor Common Area
cards.subtitle: Bailey Library · first floor
cards.notes: Set up here when you want a shared library setting. The university identifies this first-floor common area as a place for collaboration and ambient sound.
cards.short_summary: A collaborative library workspace with some background activity.
cards.evidence_claim: SRU describes Bailey Library's first-floor common area as an expansive space where students can collaborate and work with ambient sound.
cards.source_title: Ten best places to study on SRU’s campus
cards.access_notes: Located in Bailey Library; consult current library access information before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Bailey Library Third-Floor Quiet Study Area
cards.title: Bailey Library Third-Floor Quiet Study Area
cards.subtitle: Bailey Library · third floor
cards.notes: Bring independent reading or writing work to the third floor. Use one of the individual desks by the column windows and keep the quiet-floor purpose in mind.
cards.short_summary: A designated quiet library floor with individual desks and column-window seating.
cards.evidence_claim: SRU identifies Bailey Library's third floor as a designated quiet floor with individual desks facing the column windows.
cards.source_title: Ten best places to study on SRU’s campus
cards.access_notes: SRU's disability-services guidance calls the third floor a quiet-floor-only area; consult current library access information.

cards.entity_name: Bailey Library Second-Floor Individual Learning Spaces
cards.title: Bailey Library Second-Floor Individual Learning Spaces
cards.subtitle: Bailey Library · second floor
cards.notes: Choose an individual learning space for focused solo work. SRU says the six spaces are windowless and available first-come, first-served.
cards.short_summary: Six private individual learning spaces for focused work.
cards.evidence_claim: SRU reports that Bailey Library has six individual learning spaces on its second floor, available first-come, first-served.
cards.source_title: Ten best places to study on SRU’s campus
cards.access_notes: Six spaces are described as first-come, first-served; verify current library access policies before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Robert M. Smith Student Center Ballroom Entrance Seating
cards.title: Robert M. Smith Student Center Ballroom Entrance Seating
cards.subtitle: Smith Student Center · third floor
cards.notes: Head to the third-floor Ballroom entrance for couch seating by campus-facing windows. It suits a pause between classes with a broad lower-campus view.
cards.short_summary: Third-floor couch seating beside windows overlooking lower campus.
cards.evidence_claim: SRU identifies couches near the third-floor Ballroom entrance in the Smith Student Center and notes that the windows overlook lower campus.
cards.source_title: Ten best places to study on SRU’s campus
cards.access_notes: This is near the Ballroom entrance on the Student Center's third floor; event activity may affect availability.

cards.title: Miller Theater Lobby
cards.subtitle: Performing Arts Center · Miller Theater
cards.notes: Use the Miller Theater lobby when tables, chairs, and couches fit the work you need to do. Check the performing-arts schedule before relying on the space.
cards.short_summary: An open performing-arts lobby furnished with tables, chairs, and couches.
cards.evidence_claim: SRU says the Performing Arts Center's Miller Theater lobby offers tables, chairs, and couches as a place to study.
cards.source_title: Ten best places to study on SRU’s campus
cards.access_notes: Located in the Performing Arts Center lobby for Miller Theater; availability may vary with events.

cards.title: Spotts World Culture Building Room 213
cards.subtitle: Spotts World Culture Building · Room 213
cards.notes: Use Room 213 for desk work between classes. SRU's study-locations guide lists it as a study space, and its campus feature notes windows toward The Quad.
cards.short_summary: A designated study room with windows facing The Quad.
cards.evidence_claim: SRU's study-locations guide lists Spotts World Culture Building Room 213 as a study space; an SRU feature describes windows facing The Quad.
cards.access_notes: Listed by SRU as Spotts World Culture Building Room 213; confirm room availability around scheduled classes.

cards.entity_name: Engineering Student Lounge and Study Center
cards.title: Engineering Student Lounge and Study Center
cards.subtitle: Engineering facilities
cards.notes: If your coursework brings you to Engineering, use this lounge and study center for homework or a break between classes. It is described for engineering majors.
cards.short_summary: An engineering-focused lounge and study center for coursework and breaks.
cards.evidence_claim: SRU describes the Engineering Student Lounge and Study Center as a place where engineering majors study, complete homework, and take breaks.
cards.access_notes: SRU describes this as an Engineering student lounge and study center; suitability and access may be tied to the department.

cards.title: North Hall Fireplace Lounge
cards.subtitle: North Hall
cards.notes: Pair a focused indoor session with a quick move to the adjacent courtyard. SRU describes the Fireplace Lounge and courtyard as accessible to all students.
cards.short_summary: An indoor lounge linked directly to North Hall's courtyard.
cards.evidence_claim: SRU identifies North Hall's Fireplace Lounge and courtyard as study locations and says they are accessible to all students.
cards.source_title: Ten best places to study on SRU’s campus
cards.access_notes: SRU's feature says the Fireplace Lounge and courtyard are accessible to all students; check building access conditions when visiting.

cards.entity_name: Carruth Rizza Hall West Stairwell Seating Area
cards.title: Carruth Rizza Hall West Stairwell Seating Area
cards.subtitle: Carruth Rizza Hall · west stairwell
cards.notes: Climb to the top of Carruth Rizza's west stairwell for a small seating area overlooking Main Street. Keep stair access clear while you work.
cards.short_summary: A compact top-of-stairwell seating area with a Main Street outlook.
cards.evidence_claim: SRU describes small seating areas at the top of Carruth Rizza Hall stairwells, including a west-side area overlooking Main Street.
cards.source_title: Ten best places to study on SRU’s campus
cards.access_notes: Located at the top of the west stairwell in Carruth Rizza Hall; do not obstruct the stairwell or exit route.

cards.entity_name: Robert A. Macoskey Center Ecotherapy Garden
cards.title: Robert A. Macoskey Center Ecotherapy Garden
cards.subtitle: Robert A. Macoskey Center for Sustainable Systems Education
cards.notes: Take reading or planning outdoors at the ecotherapy garden, then use the nearby trails for a reset. Bring materials that work in changing weather.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor garden study setting within the Macoskey Center's 83-acre site.
cards.evidence_claim: SRU reports that the Macoskey Center has an ecotherapy garden and 83 acres with 2.5 miles of hiking trails.
cards.source_title: Ten best places to study on SRU’s campus
cards.access_notes: Outdoor conditions apply. The Macoskey Center lists trails and garden spaces among its facilities; check current site access before visiting.
